summary: Quiet cul-de-sac kerb, homes 10-11 m away and a steep stem.

best_section.where: East kerb at the mouth of the cul-de-sac, just off the main road

drivers.seclusion: Mapped dwellings 10-11 m away on the east side, with more homes round the cul-de-sac; lawn verges front the houses.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed dead-end street about one car wide each side; the kerb verge is private lawn, so room to stop is only the lane edge.
drivers.convention: One car parked at the bowl further down; little parking convention.

flags: Steep: 11.7% mean, 17% max, about 6% at the best section
Witton Creek 24 m away, low-lying at about 37 m is not flood-prone
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees on the west shade it in the afternoon.
